expectedResults: Watch output is local and begins only after Play; all stop or failure paths become truthful stopped or unavailable state and do not affect iPhone playback.
objective: Verify that explicit Watch Play drives local shared-renderer output without iPhone availability and that Watch state reflects the local host.
steps: With no reachable iPhone, select a supported tone and activate Watch Play; exercise stop, selection change, interruption, route loss, and engine-start failure.
title: Independent Watch audible output host integration
